title: The Hunt - Location, Tactics & Rewards

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Hunt is a story encounter in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley, found at Main road pursuit, returns later. Beating it yields Hunter's Chain Sickle (Great Waterfall, same region).

sections.title: Where to Find the The Hunt
sections.content:
Location: Main road pursuit, returns later.

Appears in: Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: • Hunter's Chain Sickle (Great Waterfall, same region)

sections.title: How to Beat the The Hunt
sections.content:
What works

  • Learn his attack rhythm first; the punish window is after the follow-up, not after the first swing.
  • He returns later in the story at a higher level, so the early fight doubles as a rehearsal.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 2 of 60 in the progression order, in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley. Before it: Zuo Shang (prologue duel). After it: Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
